source: docs/design/neon-look-style.md, Rules and Thresholds (ps-wnj.1); halo_min, monster_form_min and swarm_separation_min calibrated on v2 by ps-wnj.21 (demo3d/evidence/look/metrics); the restraint rules (floor_p99, background_light, flash_frames) by ps-wnj.24 (game/evidence/look/restraint, demo3d/evidence/look/restraint); halo moved to impact frames by ps-wnj.19 and bright_share_min's sparse stills by ps-wnj.29 (demo3d/evidence/look/trailer); monster_form_min's and swarm_separation_min's tiles scaled to the bodies' height on screen by ps-wnj.30 (game/evidence/look/body-tiles); swarm_separation_min's hull seams and its four dense tiles by ps-wnj.31 (demo3d/evidence/look/hull-seams)

floor_p90_max.why: rings and breaths included, the floor stays under ground light

floor_p99_max.why: the grid's lines are a quiet background (ps-wnj.24); prism's gems halo onto the floor

background_light_max.why: the world never drowns the swarm: the background carries a small share of the frame's light (ps-wnj.24)

frame_p25_max.why: the video fallback for the floor: the darkest quarter is void

black_share_min.why: a swarm is lit things with dark between them

bright_share_max.why: light comes from emitters, not a lit world

bright_share_min.why: something emits; a staged sparse still (the duel's three elites, monsters on 3% of the frame) is judged by its hero margin and readability instead (ps-wnj.29)

clipped_impact_max.why: even an impact frame is not a white-out

clipped_blob_max.why: no blown-out region outside impact frames

white_max.why: white is earned: impact frames, sparks and the blade's flare

halo_impact_min.why: emitters glow at a special moment: the post's halo flares on its impact frame (ps-wnj.19); steady frames are calm (ps-wnj.24), so no steady halo rule

families_max.why: the hue budget: the zone's key and three enemy families

key60_min.why: each frame has a colour key

key60_median_min.why: a cut keys as GW3 does

palette_conformance_min.why: everything drawn takes its colour from a role

shot_floor_range_max.why: one world across the shots, not stitched parts

flash_frames_max.why: flashes are for special moments: at most half the steady stills hold a near-white region over 0.3% of the frame (ps-wnj.24)

hero_margin_min.why: the hero is the brightest thing on screen

monster_form_min.why: a monster shows form, not flat paint (in tiles grown with the bodies' height on screen)

swarm_separation_min.why: a dense clump of one type reads as individuals, not a blob (in tiles grown with that type's height on screen; fewer than four dense tiles are no clump)

readability_min.why: monsters stand off the ground round them (TD15)
